description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 04.07.2016 to 10.07.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. This content involves the exercise of regulatory powers and the establishment of compliance requirements for import/export activities, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
